title: 30 Years Since the Prologue
altTitles: 30 Years Have Passed Since the Prologue
It's Been 30 Years Since the Prologue
Thirty Years Have Passed Since the Prologue
description: I transmigrated into a world I'd never seen before. For thirty years, I believed I was living in a classic fantasy RPG. I became a war hero, retired, and thought I was finally about to see the ending. But those thirty years were only the prologue. It turns out the real story is about an academy.
author: Mak Ellaha / Girin Geurin
